evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v. Transsilvania: Transsilvania, s. Septem castra
terms.comment: The land beyond the forest; Graesse spells it Transsilvania and files it under Septem castra. The long ā is Morgan–Owens’s marking. A country takes a preposition: in Transilvāniam (to), in Transilvāniā (in), ē Transilvāniā (from).

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio, geographical section, with the authorities it cites (cited as M-O s.v.).

J. G. Th. Graesse, Orbis Latinus, edition of F. Benedict (1909), Latin–German, read in the digitization at columbia.edu (cited as Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v.); its forms are post-classical unless Lewis & Short has them.
